environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through an interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalServiceCallerRole. The VPC endpoint's security group (sg-0xdeadbeef) allows inbound TCP/8080 only from CIDR 10.0.48.0/20 (the internal service mesh subnet). Route tables for the private subnet have NO 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. DNS resolution for the service hostname resolves only within the VPC via Route53 private hosted zone. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/NoPublicNetworkBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for public subnets.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in isolated private subnet
config.network_exposure: AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint only
config.route_table: no 0.0.0.0/0 route, no IGW, no NAT
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, no public DNS record
config.caller_authentication: mTLS via service mesh sidecar, caller identity verified against InternalServiceCallerRole
